content:
Alice M.: Heads up — we're proposing a small RBAC cleanup for the Console. Collapse ReadOnly+Viewer into a single `Viewer` and tighten `Editor` so it no longer implies billing-read or KMS key grant. Need quick review and migration plan. @Bob K. @Carla (Compliance)
Bob K.: What's the exact permission delta? Will any existing customers lose access unexpectedly? :thinking_face:
Alice M.: Editors will keep product-level edit perms but will explicitly NOT get `billing:read` or `kms:grant_key` unless they also have Admin/SRE roles. We have a migration mapping script to record pre/post mappings so we can revert.
Dmitri (ENG): UI note — console gating currently checks `can_view_billing` flag. We'll add a feature flag `rbac_v2_ui_gating` and fallback to legacy mapping if the flag is off. Also need to ensure the frontend hides billing nav for editors immediately.
Carla (Compliance): From audit perspective we need a mapped audit export showing: user, old_roles, new_roles, timestamp, and policy that triggered the change. Also want KMS ops to log principal and operation name (no secrets). Retention 365 days.
Bob K.: Any known regressions? Do we have unit/e2e to catch accidental visibility of invoices? I can run a canary cohort.
Dmitri (ENG): Found a staging bug: legacy `can_view_billing` was still true for some editor legacy users because of a stale mapping table. Pushed a patch to hide checkout nav by default in the UI and opened PR SEC-2026-12. Patch contains UI guard and a test.
---
Dmitri (ENG): migration snippet for ops (dry-run):
```
# dry-run: don't write changes
for user in users:
  old = get_roles(user)
  new = map_roles(old)
  log_dryrun(user, old, new)
```
---
Alice M.: Plan proposal — (1) enable `rbac_v2_ui_gating` behind feature flag this week, (2) run migration script dry-run and produce audit export, (3) 48h staging canary, (4) 7-day prod canary at 5% then 100%. Need approvals by EOD today.
Carla (Compliance): Approved as long as audit export schema is provided and retention is 365d. Also need a one-paragraph Rationale for auditors about KMS changes.
Dmitri (ENG): PR: https://git.internal/redwood/console/pulls/981 — CI passed. I'll run dry-run on staging at 1763504365 and post the export. Ticket SEC-2026-12 created for vuln/edge-case triage.
deploy-bot: deploy started: staging/console at sha abc123 — started by dmitri — 1763504375
audit-bot: dry-run audit export uploaded to s3: s3://redwood-audits/rbac-migration/dryrun-1763504368.csv
Bob K.: If we see authz errors in canary, plan is: auto-create a `temporary-bypass` token that grants minimal access for 1h and opens a ticket, plus rollback toggle. Agreed?
Alice M.: Temporary bypass ok but must be gated: only SecurityOps can create, must be logged by audit-bot, and expiration enforced. Add alert if authz-error-rate > 0.1% after rollout.
Carla (Compliance): I'll update the role-matrix doc in docs repo and open a PR with the new column mappings and auditor rationale.
Bob K.: I'll coordinate the 5% canary and monitor 500/403 spikes. Ping here when staging export is ready.
Dmitri (ENG): Will post staging dry-run export and a short changelog. Also adding e2e that simulates an Editor hitting billing and expects 403.
Alice M.: Thanks all — keep thread updated. If any blocker, escalate to oncall and mark SEC-2026-12.
